items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring during Wednesday's practice (Houston Chronicle); missed five games on a hammy pull in 2024. Crucial MRI results expected Thursday. He ran 37 of 42 routes last week.
items.why: Hamstring injury at practice with prior multi-game history; high route share indicates major role if healthy.
items.implication: Monitor MRI closely; potential multi-week absence elevates HOU WR depth if OUT.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, an indication he could return on Sunday.
items.why: Full participant after ankle issue signals readiness for Week 2 return.
items.implication: Likely active and involved in NE backfield; reduces backup opportunity.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Non-participant with hamstring raises Week 2 availability questions.
items.implication: Potential limited role or absence opens DEN RB committee shares.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday; got mental reps and expects to play Sunday.
items.why: Back tightness caused DNP but player expects to play vs Texans.
items.implication: Likely active; CIN pass game (Chase/Higgins) remains viable if he goes.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery to quicken recovery; minimum four-game absence.
items.implication: Opens targets for Bateman/Moore in BAL WR room per ETR.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week per FF Happy Hour.
items.why: Top waiver add amid 49ers WR injury (Stribling IR).
items.implication: Immediate add for volume/role expansion in WAS or SF context; aligns with ETR beneficiary.

items.text: Ladd McConkey listed as injury with beneficiary Tre’ Harris on ETR Week 2 waiver injury report; McConkey DNP Wednesday (rib).
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 led to Wed DNP; ETR flags as waiver injury event.
items.implication: If OUT/limited, Tre Harris and Quentin Johnston see expanded routes/targets.

items.text: De’Zhaun Stribling IR (ankle surgery, ~10 weeks/late Nov); ETR flags Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson as beneficiaries available on waivers.
items.why: Ankle deltoid rupture repaired; multi-week absence confirmed by Rapoport/Schefter.
items.implication: Elevates Deebo (and others) for increased opportunity in 49ers offense.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year—scary. DNP Wednesday, day-to-day.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery; coach hopes practice this week, injury not overly serious per reports.
items.implication: If returns, TE1 upside; else Mayer elevated. Monitor practices.

items.text: First ROS rankings show live discussing where to rank if season started today: CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty, Jalen Coker and more (Levitan et al).
items.implication: Reassess rankings for these high-opportunity players amid early usage/injury.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but simply played a horrific game.
items.why: High xFP (targets/location/depth model) indicates strong opportunity that efficiency failed to convert.
items.implication: Positive regression candidate; maintain or buy low on role.

items.text: ETR Week 2 injury report flags Alvin Kamara = Kendre Miller as waiver beneficiary pair.
items.why: Kamara status monitored; Miller primary beneficiary if limited/absent.
items.implication: Stash Miller where Kamara owned; Kamara full practice notes elsewhere suggest likely play.

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 last night); needs serious volume. Only two targets (7% share) but routes strong: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd).
items.why: High route participation but low aDOT/volume limits ceiling without target increase.
items.implication: Volume-dependent; track targets ROS for viability. Discussed in ETR ROS rankings.

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man! (MNF reaction love).
items.why: Strong MNF performance and role as workhorse affirmed.
items.implication: Start with confidence; aligns with high opportunity usage notes.
